name: Alienware Battery
author: xyzlab
description: A battery indicator for the Omarchy bar without the power-profiles picker, so it does not fight Alienware thermal profiles. Shows charge, rate, time left, size and cycles, and switches thermal profiles through alienwarectl when it is installed.

barWidget.description: Battery charge and time left, with Alienware thermal profiles instead of power profiles.

schema.label: Show the charge percentage beside the icon
Charge that turns the icon urgent on battery (%)
Show Alienware thermal profiles when alienwarectl is installed
